autoDecisions: [AUTO-DECISION] GuidedError fields: error.schema.json requires requestId, retryable and messageCode and defines optional detail; it has no reason. The plan sketch said messageCode?/retryable?/reason?. The schema wins (reason: invent nothing).

[AUTO-DECISION] FinalizeRequest is publication.schema.json's root (schemaVersion, expectedSourceRevision, expectedConfigurationRevision), which is what the openapi finalizeObservedPublication requestBody references. commands.schema.json#/definitions/finalize (ownerFence, hashes) is the internal bridge body and is not used.

[AUTO-DECISION] ClarifyRequest is {schemaVersion, clarificationId, choiceId, generation} per commands.schema.json#/definitions/clarify; the plan said 'answer(choiceId)', which the hook satisfies by reading clarificationId and generation from the pending question.

[AUTO-DECISION] GuidedStartRequest hints are independent optionals (openapi: 'each optional request hint is checked independently'), unlike PublicSession where baseRevisionId and firstLearnStepId must appear together.

[AUTO-DECISION] readResult needs the HTTP status (200 final vs 202 pending) but apiClient resolves to the body only. studioGuidedApi.readResult passes a per-request transformResponse that keeps axios's default parsing and wraps only 2xx bodies with the status (axios 1.11 passes status as the third argument). Error bodies are left untouched so the client's error normalizer still works. apiClient.ts is not edited.

[AUTO-DECISION] GuidedPendingReason = REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED (401), NOT_READY (503 or rejected validation at FINALIZING), PUBLICATION_PENDING (202 result). The plan names 'pending' without a type; these three come from the plan's AC-2 prose and the openapi 202 description. Open to amendment in the body step.

[AUTO-DECISION] GuidedStartRefusal = {httpStatus, error: GuidedError | null, platformCode, retryAfterSeconds}. The platform RATE_LIMITED 429 and the authentication 503 have no v3 body (openapi 429 and video 503 descriptions).
[AUTO-DECISION] GUIDED_TERMINAL_STATES copies the backend's own set (GuidedSessionService.TERMINAL), because the contract documents terminality only in prose.

[AUTO-DECISION] newGuidedIdempotencyKey duplicates the private UUID helper in run/useRunGate.ts (L5b's file, not mine). Contract only needs 1..256 characters; a v4 UUID keeps it compatible with the platform idempotency filter.

[AUTO-DECISION] Session reads keep apiClient's default GET retry (2 retries on 5xx or network error). Only getCapabilities opts out (__doNotRetry, plan P1). The body step may add opt-outs for the polling reads if the 503-as-not-ready mapping needs the first answer.
[AUTO-DECISION] Client is a single object studioGuidedApi (matches studioApi) with a default export; the plan listed function names without a shape.
